data.completion_memo: Created the automated Milestone 08 Chat/evidence regression suite and executable QA runner. Coverage includes first send versus queued input, IME and draft retention, projection gap/resync, terminal controls, rich-content escaping and unknown cards, virtual-window behavior, and paged explicit evidence states. The runner validates local trusted-core contracts, desktop tests, strict TypeScript, and a production Vite build.
data.description: Create automated QA tests for the complete Milestone 08 desktop vertical slice against a real local core. Cover first send and workflow lock, queued input, approvals, pause/cancel/retry/fork/continue, IME and draft retention, streaming scroll/virtualization, projection disconnect/resync, malformed and unknown cards, evidence paging/redaction, keyboard navigation, and accepted Chat mockup conformance.
data.title: M08.QA — Create QA tests for the desktop Chat and evidence experience
